description: Operational view for the Slinky Slurm-on-CAPI workload cluster: Slurm demand, NodeSet capacity, Kubernetes readiness, pod resources, and optional InfiniBand counters.

options.content: Slurm jobs -> slurmctld Prometheus metrics -> KEDA NodeSet scaling -> pending slurmd pods -> CAPI/CAPZ machine capacity -> new compute node -> slurmd registers back with Slurm. This dashboard is intentionally workload-Prometheus scoped: it uses Slurm exporter metrics, kube-state-metrics, cAdvisor, and node-exporter data that are already present in the cluster.

title: Slinky Slurm on CAPI: Architecture Overview
